episodes.title: The Season of Unfoldment
episodes.summary: After Asha is kidnapped, her elder sister Amy teaches her the rules of Blackmarsh.

episodes.title: Kindred
episodes.summary: Blamed for Asha's bad behavior, Amy is forced to take LSD as part of her clearing for her sins.

episodes.title: Suffer the Little Children
episodes.summary: Police raid Blackmarsh to rescue the children. Wayne tells Freya their daughter might have run away.

episodes.title: The Foundlings
episodes.summary: Adrienne has been found in Paris while Freya sees Dr. Latham giving a talk on The Kindred.

episodes.title: Maitreya
episodes.summary: Believing she has powers to walk through time, Dr Latham helps Adrienne form The Kindred.

episodes.title: The Pied Piper
episodes.summary: Adrienne is extradited and Henrik is released from prison not revealing what happened to Asha.

episodes.title: This Too Shall Pass
episodes.summary: Freya warns Adrienne she'll have her arrested if she reforms The Kindred.

episodes.title: Island
episodes.summary: Searching for Billy, Freya finds Adrienne on a private island relaunching The Kindred.
